name: SpawnLocation
simple: A SpawnLocation is a special part where players appear when they join and after they die. It can be open to everyone or only to one team. It also gives freshly spawned players a short-lived ForceField so nobody can attack them right away.
analogy: A SpawnLocation is like a starting line in a race. Everyone (or every runner on a certain team) lines up there at the start, and again after they're knocked out.
whenToUse: Choose where players appear in your world.
Make different start areas for different teams.
Make obby checkpoints: touch a spawn and you'll respawn there next time.
where: In Workspace. Insert one from the Model tab in Studio, or with `Instance.new("SpawnLocation")`. It is a kind of Part, so it has all the normal Part properties (Size, Color, Anchored...) too.

terms.spawn: Appearing in the world with a new character.
terms.ForceField: The sparkly bubble around a just-spawned player. It blocks explosions and TakeDamage while it lasts.
terms.spawn killing: Attacking players the moment they appear, before they can move. ForceFields help stop it.
terms.neutral: Not tied to any team. A neutral spawn can be used by anyone.
terms.TeamColor: The BrickColor that links a spawn to the Team with the same color.
terms.checkpoint: A save point in an obby. After falling, you start from the last checkpoint instead of the beginning.

examples.title: Team-only spawns
examples.place: Set up in Studio (no script needed)
examples.code:
-- 1. In Teams, add a Team. Name it "Blue Team", set TeamColor to Bright blue.
-- 2. In Workspace, add a SpawnLocation.
-- 3. On the SpawnLocation: untick Neutral, set TeamColor to Bright blue.
-- Now only Blue Team players spawn here.

-- Same setup done by script (Script in ServerScriptService):
local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Anchored = true
spawn.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
spawn.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 40)
spawn.Neutral = false
spawn.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
spawn.Parent = workspace
explain: Neutral = false means 'only one team can use this spawn'.
TeamColor must exactly match the Team's TeamColor.
If more than one spawn fits a player, Roblox picks one at random.
SpawnLocation.TeamColor is about which team can use it. The part's BrickColor/Color is just how it looks.

examples.title: Obby checkpoints
examples.place: Studio setup plus a Script in ServerScriptService
examples.code:
-- For each checkpoint: make a Team (e.g. "Stage 1", "Stage 2") with its own TeamColor,
-- and a SpawnLocation with the same TeamColor, Neutral off, and AllowTeamChangeOnTouch on.
-- Only the Stage 1 team should have AutoAssignable on, so new players start there.

-- Optional: a simpler checkpoint without teams, using RespawnLocation
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local checkpoint = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoint2") -- a SpawnLocation (Neutral on)

checkpoint.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
    if player then
        player.RespawnLocation = checkpoint -- next respawn happens here
    end
end)
explain: With AllowTeamChangeOnTouch, touching the spawn switches you to its team, so you'll respawn on it next time.
The second way skips teams: Player.RespawnLocation picks which SpawnLocation the player uses next time.
RespawnLocation only works if the spawn is Neutral or matches the player's TeamColor.

gotchas: Set the spawn's Anchored to true, or it may fall or be pushed away.
TeamColor is not the same as the part's visible Color or BrickColor.
If no spawn fits a player (for example all are locked to other teams), they won't spawn where you expect.
ForceFields only stop damage that respects them (explosions and Humanoid:TakeDamage). Setting Health directly ignores them.

SpawnLocation.AllowTeamChangeOnTouch.simple: If true, a player who touches this spawn switches to its team (their TeamColor becomes the spawn's TeamColor, and Neutral matches the spawn's Neutral). Used for checkpoints. Does nothing if Enabled is false.

SpawnLocation.Duration.simple: How many seconds the spawn ForceField lasts on players who appear here. Default 10. 0 means no ForceField at all.

SpawnLocation.Enabled.simple: If false, nobody can spawn here and touching it won't change teams. The easiest way to turn a spawn off.

SpawnLocation.Neutral.simple: If true, any player of any team can spawn here. If false, only players whose TeamColor matches the spawn's TeamColor can.

SpawnLocation.TeamColor.simple: Which team this spawn belongs to (by color). Only matters when Neutral is false. Must match the Team's TeamColor.
